pose.scope: Fixed fully-open research geometry, treated as restrained for this CFD study; no prediction of spontaneous lift, force equilibrium, or closing behavior

domain.scope: Port-to-port pressure loss includes numerical straight extensions and developing/disturbed flow; not automatically the isolated-valve coefficient

pressure_interpretation.field: simpleFoam p has dimensions m2/s2; multiply by rho for Pa
pressure_interpretation.scope: 0.63 MPa(g) is a separate structural study load, not an imposed flow pressure drop. The initial CFD property state remains the validated atmospheric reference. Explicit gravity is omitted from this constant-density flow equation; physical vertical pressure-force postprocessing needs a separately stated hydrostatic reconstruction and contact-wetting check.

formulas.measured_flow: Use the actual outward-normal surface flux phi: Qin<0 and Qout>0
formulas.loss_coefficient_reporting: Use a declared reference velocity Q_actual/(pi*D^2/4); distinguish static, total-pressure, port-to-port and pipe-corrected quantities

execution_prerequisites: Current mesh files bound to a fresh full checkMesh PASS with all warnings retained
Nonzero-source Poisson verification on this valve domain and appropriate mesh/scheme sensitivity
Actual case input hashes, solver/library fingerprints before launch
Residual history, pressure-drop/flow stabilization, mass balance, finite/bounded fields and model-specific near-wall checks
drawing_note24_coefficient_limit_assessm: UNASSESSED: governing test/tap and operating-flow conditions not established; no automatic <=6 pass from a port coefficient
modeling_limits: Study speeds are deliberate sensitivity values, not sourced rated product flow or user operating data
The Re10 held-open case is a numerical diagnostic, not expected natural valve operation
No coupled disc motion, water hammer, cavitation, leakage, thermal stress or pressure-dependent property validation
No source standard or manufacturer rating is inferred from solver convergence
